name: campuslab-ai
description: CampusLab AI - Intelligent Laboratory Resource Sharing Platform

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm --prefix backend run db:push && npm --prefix backend run seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
